FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Answers about cloud migration, platforms, security, and how we partner with enterprise teams.

Contact support
How long does a cloud migration take?
Most enterprise migrations take a few weeks to several months, depending on workload complexity, after a detailed assessment.
Can you migrate legacy applications?
Yes. We modernize, refactor, or rehost legacy systems based on what your business actually needs.
How do you handle security during migration?
Encryption, identity management, continuous monitoring, and compliance frameworks are built in from the first phase, not added after.
Which cloud platforms do you support?
AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and hybrid or multi-cloud environments.
Do you offer managed cloud services?
Yes — monitoring, optimization, security, backup, disaster recovery, and ongoing support.
Is the initial consultation free?
Yes. We'll assess your current infrastructure and recommend a modernization strategy at no cost.
